format: BUFR (PrepBUFR .nr cycle file + GPS-RO BUFR dump), decoded with earth2bufr
notes: No model in the repo pairs with this source (only CHANGELOG and lexicon/data docstrings mention it); variables are the full GDASObsConvLexicon VOCAB (7 keys).

ROLLING ARCHIVE: NOMADS keeps about 2 days (_MAX_AGE_DAYS = 2, gdas.py:65) with 6-10 h latency. Update `time` to a 6-hourly cycle from the last ~36 h before every run; the value here was valid on 2026-11-13.
Default time_tolerance (10 min) and layout='long' kept; layout='wide' would reject PrepBUFR and GPS-RO variables in one call (gdas.py:243).
